Note: 1. All applicants whose application have been accepted are instructed to attend document verification with all
original documents along with required deficit documents (original and one set of photocopies of deficit
documents) as mentioned against their names in support of their application on 24-09-2025, between
10:00 AM to 3:00 PM, at the Veterinary College, Hebbal, Bengaluru campus.
2. After verification of original documents, the list of eligible cum merit and ineligible candidates will be
announced on 24-09-2025, after 6:00 PM.
3. Eligible candidates are instructed to attend the counselling process on 25-09-2025, starting at 10:00 AM
at the Veterinary College, Hebbal, Bengaluru campus (reporting time: 9:30 AM).
4. Candidates should be prepared to pay the prescribed fees (Institutional Economic fee and regular
fee) on 25-09-2025, if allotted the seat.
5. Candidates must bring all originals documents and two set of photocopies of all documents, including the
application form, on the day of counselling (25-09-2025).
6. All provisionally admitted candidates are required to submit notary affidavit of the undertaking on ₹ 100
stamp paper (Annexure) at time of reporting to allotted college. The first party will be the
candidate/parents, and the second party will be the Registrar, KVAFSU, Bidar.
“Issued with approval of the competent authority”
